attributes.description: What data was read, by whom, through which transport action - including system indices.

params.markdown:
### What data was read or written in Elasticsearch, and by whom

See which indices each identity uses, the kinds of requests they made, any denied requests, and every touch of system or hidden indices.

Related indices are grouped into one family, so a data stream and its daily backing indices read as a single row. Use it to confirm that sensitive data is reached only by the people and keys you expect.

**How to use it:** choose a Project, Person (email) or Client IP in the controls and set the time picker. Empty denied and system-index panels usually mean all is well.

query.esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE service.name == "serverless-elasticsearch" | STATS `Elasticsearch events` = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE service.name == "serverless-elasticsearch" | STATS `Elasticsearch events` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: All Elasticsearch audit events in range.

query.esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("indices:data/read/esql/search_shards", "indices:data/read/esql/data"))) | STATS BY elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL family = REPLACE(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | EVAL family = REPLACE(family, """[-.]\d{8}[-.T]?\d{6}(?:[-.].*)?$""", "*") | EVAL family = CASE(LEFT(family, 1) == ".", CONCAT(REPLACE(family, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.(?:alert-actions|[^-._]+)).*$""", "$1"), "*"), family) | STATS `Index families` = COUNT_DISTINCT(family)

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("indices:data/read/esql/search_shards", "indices:data/read/esql/data"))) | STATS BY elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL family = REPLACE(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | EVAL family = REPLACE(family, """[-.]\d{8}[-.T]?\d{6}(?:[-.].*)?$""", "*") | EVAL family = CASE(LEFT(family, 1) == ".", CONCAT(REPLACE(family, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.(?:alert-actions|[^-._]+)).*$""", "$1"), "*"), family) | STATS `Index families` = COUNT_DISTINCT(family)

embeddableConfig.description: Distinct index families named in audited requests - the rows Top index families and the matrix would list with no cut. A data stream and its backing indices are one family, as is a run of dated daily indices or of per-run indices stamped with a date and time (syn-tmp-20261014-152111-… is syn-tmp*), and system and hidden indices count once per area (.alerts*, .slo*, .kibana*…), the groups the system-index table names. Wildcard and date-math expressions (*, -*, <…{now/d}>) are patterns, not indices, and are left out.

query.esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | STATS BY elasticsearch.audit.action | WHERE NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql/*") | STATS `Distinct actions` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | STATS BY elasticsearch.audit.action | WHERE NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql/*") | STATS `Distinct actions` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: Distinct Elasticsearch transport actions (cluster:*, indices:*), with shard-level copies and ES|QL sub-steps folded away - the same actions Top transport actions lists, all traffic.

query.esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/esql" | STATS `ES|QL queries` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/esql" | STATS `ES|QL queries` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: ES|QL queries submitted - one per query, not per shard or sub-step. Includes the queries these dashboards run to draw themselves. Equals the indices:data/read/esql row in Top transport actions. The range ends a minute ago, so nothing in it is still arriving; each panel reads the clock for itself, up to a second apart, so two panels side by side can differ by the events of that second at either end of the range: usually none, a few on a busy all-traffic count or during a burst.

query.esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | STATS `System index access` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | STATS `System index access` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: Requests touching dot-prefixed system and hidden indices (.kibana*, .security*, .slo-*, .alerts-*), counted once per index named. Backing indices of ordinary data streams (.ds-logs-…) are not system data and are left out, as are shard-level copies of a request.

query.esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.action == "access_denied" OR event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS `Access denied` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.action == "access_denied" OR event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS `Access denied` = COUNT(*)

embeddableConfig.description: Authorization denials. Sustained non-zero values mean a misconfigured client or a probe.

query.esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), elasticsearch.audit.action, request = elasticsearch.audit.request.name | WHERE NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql/*") AND NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/search" AND COALESCE(request, "-") == "") | EVAL family = CASE(elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read*", "read", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/write*", "write", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin*", "index admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin/xpack/security*", "security admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin*", "cluster admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*:monitor*", "monitor", "other") | STATS events = SUM(n) BY time, family | SORT family

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), elasticsearch.audit.action, request = elasticsearch.audit.request.name | WHERE NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql/*") AND NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/search" AND COALESCE(request, "-") == "") | EVAL family = CASE(elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read*", "read", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/write*", "write", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin*", "index admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin/xpack/security*", "security admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin*", "cluster admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*:monitor*", "monitor", "other") | STATS events = SUM(n) BY time, family | SORT family

embeddableConfig.description: Every Elasticsearch request that names a transport action, by kind of action - all traffic, the searches and ES|QL these dashboards run among the reads. Shard-level copies, ES|QL sub-steps and the search an async search runs for itself are folded away so a request counts once, and authentication and connection events (which name no action) are left out, so it sums to less than the Elasticsearch events tile. The legend gives each family's total, so a family too small to see as a bar is still counted; Lens leaves the partial bucket at the right edge, the one the range's end cuts through, out of those totals (up to half an hour at 24h), so they run behind the bars and the tiles. A stretch with no bars means no audited Elasticsearch request in that span - on a wide range that includes the time before the project's audit stream began.
embeddableConfig.title: Data access over time by action family

embeddableConfig.description: The 10 busiest identities across the top, and down the side the index families they read, busiest first in the same order as Top index families (each family's events from every identity), up to 25; cell colour is audit events on a log scale, teal (fewest) through blue and purple to pink (most), and the line above the matrix says how many of each it shows. A data stream and its backing indices are one family, as is a run of dated daily indices or of per-run indices stamped with a date and time (syn-tmp-20261014-152111-… is syn-tmp*), and system and hidden indices are one family per area (.alerts*, .slo*, .kibana*…), the groups the system-index table names; wildcard and date-math expressions are left out. A blank cell means that identity did not touch that family in range - or touched it too little to be among the 500 busiest identity/family pairs. Events counts a request once per index it names: shard-level copies and the ES|QL engine's per-shard steps name the same indices again and are left out, so it is the same count as Top index families. An identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key, which the audit stream records only by its opaque id. Cells keep a heatmap's size and pack to the top left when only a few identities or families are in range, so a sparse window draws a small matrix with its legend under it, not a few cells adrift in the panel; with three identities or fewer each column widens to fit its label.
embeddableConfig.title: Who reads which index family · up to 10 identities

query.esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("indices:data/read/esql/search_shards", "indices:data/read/esql/data"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), index = REPLACE(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | EVAL index = REPLACE(index, """[-.]\d{8}[-.T]?\d{6}(?:[-.].*)?$""", "*") | EVAL index = CASE(LEFT(index, 1) == ".", CONCAT(REPLACE(index, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.(?:alert-actions|[^-._]+)).*$""", "$1"), "*"), index) | STATS n = SUM(n) BY index, actor | EVAL k = CONCAT(TO_STRING(n + 1000000000000), actor) | STATS events = SUM(n), actors = COUNT(*), top = MAX(k) BY index | SORT events DESC, index | LIMIT 14 | EVAL busiest = SUBSTRING(top, 14) | EVAL busiest = CASE((LENGTH(busiest) == 20 AND busiest RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT busiest RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(busiest, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), busiest) | KEEP index, busiest, actors, events

SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("indices:data/read/esql/search_shards", "indices:data/read/esql/data"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), index = REPLACE(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | EVAL index = REPLACE(index, """[-.]\d{8}[-.T]?\d{6}(?:[-.].*)?$""", "*") | EVAL index = CASE(LEFT(index, 1) == ".", CONCAT(REPLACE(index, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.(?:alert-actions|[^-._]+)).*$""", "$1"), "*"), index) | STATS n = SUM(n) BY index, actor | EVAL k = CONCAT(TO_STRING(n + 1000000000000), actor) | STATS events = SUM(n), actors = COUNT(*), top = MAX(k) BY index | SORT events DESC, index | LIMIT 14 | EVAL busiest = SUBSTRING(top, 14) | EVAL busiest = CASE((LENGTH(busiest) == 20 AND busiest RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT busiest RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(busiest, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), busiest) | KEEP index, busiest, actors, events

embeddableConfig.description: The busiest index families, all traffic; the Index families tile counts every one, so the rest are beyond this list. Identities is how many distinct identities touched the family, and Busiest identity is the one with the most events against it - over a quiet hour the list is often only the audit stream itself, read by the identity these dashboards run as. A data stream and its backing indices are one row, as is a run of dated daily indices or of per-run indices stamped with a date and time (syn-tmp-20261014-152111-… is syn-tmp*), and system and hidden indices are one row per area (.alerts*, .slo*, .kibana*…), as in the system-index table: one request naming ten alert indices is one .alerts* row, not ten. Events counts a request once per index it names, so a system area's events per identity are the system-index table's; shard-level copies and the ES|QL engine's per-shard steps name the same indices again and are left out (an ES|QL query counts once, by the step that resolves its indices). Wildcard and date-math expressions are left out. The same count the matrix beside it colours, and the matrix lists its families in this order. A Busiest identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key, which the audit stream records only by its opaque id.
embeddableConfig.title: Top index families by events · 14 at most

query.esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.action, request = elasticsearch.audit.request.name | WHERE NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql/*") AND NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/search" AND COALESCE(request, "-") == "") | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), request = CASE(request IS NULL OR request == "", "-", request) | STATS events = SUM(n), actors = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor), last_seen = MAX(seen) BY elasticsearch.audit.action, request | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 13

SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.action, request = elasticsearch.audit.request.name | WHERE NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql/*") AND NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/search" AND COALESCE(request, "-") == "") | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), request = CASE(request IS NULL OR request == "", "-", request) | STATS events = SUM(n), actors = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor), last_seen = MAX(seen) BY elasticsearch.audit.action, request | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 13

embeddableConfig.description: The busiest Elasticsearch transport actions with their request class, all traffic - the searches and ES|QL reads these dashboards run included, since reads are what this page is about. The Distinct actions tile counts every action; the rest are beyond this list, and an action sent with two request classes is two rows. Shard-level copies, ES|QL sub-steps and the search an async search runs for itself are folded away, so a request counts once. Identities is how many distinct identities sent the action; Request "-" means the event named no request class. The range ends a minute ago, so nothing in it is still arriving; each panel reads the clock for itself, up to a second apart, so two panels side by side can differ by the events of that second at either end of the range: usually none, a few on a busy all-traffic count or during a burst.
embeddableConfig.title: Top transport actions · 13 at most

query.esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.action == "access_denied" OR event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS events = COUNT(*), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.action, elasticsearch.audit.indices | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), k = CONCAT(TO_STRING(seen), "|", COALESCE(elasticsearch.audit.action, "-"), "|", COALESCE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "-")) | STATS events = SUM(events), last_seen = MAX(seen), latest = MAX(k), actions = VALUES(elasticsearch.audit.action), indices = VALUES(elasticsearch.audit.indices) BY actor | EVAL sk = CONCAT(TO_STRING(last_seen), "|", actor) | INLINE STATS ids = COUNT(*), recent = VALUES(sk) | EVAL cut = MV_MIN(MV_SLICE(MV_SORT(recent, "DESC"), 0, 8)) | EVAL actor = CASE(ids > 10 AND sk < cut, "~rest", actor) | STATS events = SUM(events), last_seen = MAX(last_seen), latest = MAX(latest), actions = VALUES(actions), indices = VALUES(indices), folded = COUNT(*) BY actor | EVAL actor = CASE(actor == "~rest", CONCAT(TO_STRING(folded), " other identities"), actor) | EVAL latest_action = MV_SLICE(SPLIT(latest, "|"), 1), latest_index = MV_SLICE(SPLIT(latest, "|"), 2), actions = COALESCE(MV_COUNT(actions), 0), indices = COALESCE(MV_COUNT(indices), 0) | KEEP actor, latest_action, latest_index, actions, indices, events, last_seen | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 10 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.action == "access_denied" OR event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS events = COUNT(*), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.action, elasticsearch.audit.indices | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), k = CONCAT(TO_STRING(seen), "|", COALESCE(elasticsearch.audit.action, "-"), "|", COALESCE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "-")) | STATS events = SUM(events), last_seen = MAX(seen), latest = MAX(k), actions = VALUES(elasticsearch.audit.action), indices = VALUES(elasticsearch.audit.indices) BY actor | EVAL sk = CONCAT(TO_STRING(last_seen), "|", actor) | INLINE STATS ids = COUNT(*), recent = VALUES(sk) | EVAL cut = MV_MIN(MV_SLICE(MV_SORT(recent, "DESC"), 0, 8)) | EVAL actor = CASE(ids > 10 AND sk < cut, "~rest", actor) | STATS events = SUM(events), last_seen = MAX(last_seen), latest = MAX(latest), actions = VALUES(actions), indices = VALUES(indices), folded = COUNT(*) BY actor | EVAL actor = CASE(actor == "~rest", CONCAT(TO_STRING(folded), " other identities"), actor) | EVAL latest_action = MV_SLICE(SPLIT(latest, "|"), 1), latest_index = MV_SLICE(SPLIT(latest, "|"), 2), actions = COALESCE(MV_COUNT(actions), 0), indices = COALESCE(MV_COUNT(indices), 0) | KEEP actor, latest_action, latest_index, actions, indices, events, last_seen | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 10 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

embeddableConfig.description: Who was refused, newest first: one row per identity, with the action and index of its most recent denial, how many distinct actions and indices it was refused on, and its denials in range. When more identities were refused than the panel has rows, the last row (“N other identities”) holds the rest - their denials, the distinct actions and indices any of them was refused on, and the newest of their denials - so the Denials column always adds up to the Access denied tile. On index "-" with Indices 0 is a cluster-level request, with no index to count; <anonymous> with action "-" and Actions 0 is an HTTP call that carried no credentials, refused before it named an action. An Identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key: the audit stream records it only by its opaque 20-character id, shown here by its first five characters; it has no name and no owner email. An empty panel means nothing matched in the time range, which is the healthy state; any row here is worth reading.
embeddableConfig.title: Denied requests by identity · newest 10 at most (empty = good)

query.esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | STATS n = COUNT(*), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.indices, elasticsearch.audit.action | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), area = CONCAT(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.(?:alert-actions|[^-._]+)).*$""", "$1"), "*") | EVAL family = CASE(elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read*", "read", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/write*", "write", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin*", "index admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin/xpack/security*", "security admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin*", "cluster admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*:monitor*", "monitor", "other") | STATS events = SUM(n), indices = COUNT_DISTINCT(elasticsearch.audit.indices), groups = VALUES(area), kinds = VALUES(family), last_seen = MAX(seen) BY actor | EVAL groups = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(groups), ", "), kinds = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(kinds), ", ") | KEEP actor, groups, kinds, indices, events, last_seen | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 25 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | STATS n = COUNT(*), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.name, elasticsearch.audit.indices, elasticsearch.audit.action | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>"), area = CONCAT(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.(?:alert-actions|[^-._]+)).*$""", "$1"), "*") | EVAL family = CASE(elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read*", "read", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/write*", "write", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin*", "index admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin/xpack/security*", "security admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin*", "cluster admin", elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*:monitor*", "monitor", "other") | STATS events = SUM(n), indices = COUNT_DISTINCT(elasticsearch.audit.indices), groups = VALUES(area), kinds = VALUES(family), last_seen = MAX(seen) BY actor | EVAL groups = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(groups), ", "), kinds = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(kinds), ", ") | KEEP actor, groups, kinds, indices, events, last_seen | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 25 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)

embeddableConfig.description: Who touched system and hidden indices - Kibana internals, the security index, alerting and SLO data - one row per identity, newest first: the index groups it touched (.alerts*, .slo*, .kibana*…), the kinds of transport action (read, write, index admin, monitor…), how many real indices, and its requests in range, which add up to the System index access tile when every identity is in view. The Discover session below names each index and action. Backing indices of ordinary data streams (.ds-logs-…) and shard-level copies of a request are left out. Expected from Kibana and platform automation; unexpected from anyone else, and a write from anyone else is worth a look. An identity that touched many groups wraps onto a second line rather than cutting the list short. An Identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key: the audit stream records it only by its opaque 20-character id, shown here by its first five characters; it has no name and no owner email. Often empty over the default hour on a healthy project; widen the time range to see older rows. The table holds more rows than the panel shows: scroll it for the rest.
